pages.title: Where to find
pages.text: A projectile-tagged hit triggers teleportation and is rejected while the enemy is awake. Normal damage is also rejected during teleportation and sleep. Reacquire its new position before continuing a melee sequence.

pages.title: How to fight
pages.text: This profile does not use hosted preparation. Fight it normally rather than looking for Start. Defeating this enemy contributes to world-tier progression.

pages.title: What does not work
pages.text: This profile does not use hosted preparation. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.

pages.title: Drops
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Enderitium Gem, Eye Crystal. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.
